advisor.cli.enabled: The AI advisor is on. It only suggests; it never selects or changes anything.
advisor.cli.running: Asking {provider} ({version}) about {groups} groups. This can take a few minutes.
advisor.cli.none: The advisor made no group recommendations.
advisor.cli.stale: A newer scan exists, so these suggestions are out of date.
advisor.cli.footer: Suggestions only — nothing was selected or changed.
advisor.cli.payload: Payload: {bytes} bytes, {included} of {total} groups ({share} of the scanned space). The JSON holds no paths, names or file contents.
advisor.cli.command: Command that would run (the temporary paths are created at run time):
advisor.cli.stdin: Standard input: {bytes} bytes: the payload above, with the instructions in front for Codex (Claude gets them through --system-prompt).
advisor.cli.manual_dry_run: Manual mode: nothing runs. Use --export FILE to get the prompt.
advisor.cli.exported: Wrote the prompt to {path}. Paste it into a chat and save the reply to a file, then run: disk-steward advise --import FILE (valid until {expires}).
error.advisor_disabled: The AI advisor is off. Turn it on first (command line: disk-steward advise --enable).
error.advisor_provider_unavailable: The advisor provider {provider} is not available: {reason}.
error.advisor_timeout: The advisor did not answer within {seconds} seconds and was stopped.
error.advisor_left_session: The advisor's program left a record behind: {path}. Disk Steward did not touch it; delete it yourself if you do not want it.
error.advisor_output_too_large: The advisor produced too much output ({what}) and was stopped.
error.advisor_unknown_request: No such advisor request. Preview the payload again.
error.advisor_request_expired: This advisor request expired after one hour. Preview the payload again.
error.advisor_no_provider: No advisor provider is chosen. Pass --provider codex, claude or manual.
error.advisor_manual_only: Manual mode has no program to run. Use --export FILE, paste the prompt into a chat, then --import FILE with the reply.
error.advisor_scan_changed: A scan finished while the payload was being built. Try again.
error.advisor_toggle_alone: --enable and --disable cannot be combined with other options.
advisor.notice.own_instructions: Only the JSON payload shown here comes from Disk Steward. Each program adds its own instructions on top of it: Codex may include your global AGENTS.md and its built-in instructions, and Claude runs in safe mode (no CLAUDE.md, plugins or MCP servers) but still adds its built-in prompt. Disk Steward cannot show those parts.
advisor.cli.trace: Note: {provider} recorded the advisor's fixed working folder in {path}. It is one entry that every advisor call reuses.
error.advisor_cwd_not_empty: The advisor's working folder is not empty: {path}. Disk Steward keeps it empty. Delete what is inside it and try again.
